title: Show each retained named root's item tracker lifecycle (open/completed/cancelled) in the read-only GET via a bounded, off-lock tracker read; the 409 stays I/O-free
outcome: An operator reading GET /api/engram/named-roots sees, for each retained root, its item's tracker lifecycle (open/completed/cancelled), or "unknown" when the bounded read fails or times out, beside the run lifecycle as last read canonically. The full-table 409 refusal stays I/O-free and keeps showing only the canonically read run lifecycle.
acceptance: GET /api/engram/named-roots adds each retained root's item tracker lifecycle (open, completed or cancelled), read off the state lock through the existing tracker-read path, at most one read per distinct work id per request, within a stated budget; a failed, refused or timed-out read shows 'unknown' and never fails the request
The full-table 409 refusal performs no tracker or canonical read (the existing 'the refusal did not spend any lifecycle read budget' assertion still holds) and its rows are unchanged
Tests cover an open item, a completed item, a timed-out or failed read reported as 'unknown', and the one-read-per-work bound with two roots of the same work
The full gate plus a clean review pair
